english.title: Use motor vehicle on a road when the seat belt and its anchorage / fastenings / adjustment were not maintained
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), fitted with a **(..SPECIFY LOCATION OF BELT..) seat belt in accordance with regulation 47 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, when the belt and its anchorages, fastenings and adjusting device were not maintained free from any obvious defect which would be likely to affect adversely the performance by the seat belt of the function of restraining the body of the wearer in the event of an accident to the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 48(4)(c) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) fitted with a **(..SPECIFY LOCATION OF BELT..) seat belt. Due to **(..SPECIFY DEFECT IN ANCHORAGES OF BELT ETC..), the performance of the belt in restraining the body of its wearer in the event of an accident was likely to be affected.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Level four if goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
